records.label: spacr.doctor#4
records.source: **A broken GUI dependency install.** PySide6 ships with the core package, but a missing or incomplete wheel can still make the ``spacr`` command fail on import. :mod:`spacr.qt` has a friendly path for that; :func:`check_qt_extra` reuses its logic so the two cannot drift.
